title: A Two-Branch ResNet-BiLSTM Deep Learning Framework for Extracting Multimodal Features Applied to PPG-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation.
summary: A two-branch ResNet/BiLSTM estimator was evaluated against reference blood-pressure values using 220 waveform segments from 218 MIMIC-IV patients, with held-out test performance meeting the cited AAMI/BHS thresholds. This is retrospective estimator validation, not prospective cuff replacement or clinical benefit. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
